_comment: Reference definition of the Cortex Agent Freshness Monitor workflow. It lists every block and setting; import it (Automate > Create automation > Import) or rebuild the blocks in the editor if your tenant's import format differs. Replace all <placeholder> values before enabling.
name: Snowflake Cortex Agent — Freshness SLA Monitor
description: Runs a Snowflake Cortex Agent freshness check through RUN_FRESHNESS_CHECK, alerts and reloads a Qlik app on breach, and alerts if the check itself fails. The procedure writes the audit record.

triggers.comment: Runs every 4 hours. Adjust to match your SLA check cadence.

blocks.name: Start — Scheduled or Webhook
blocks.comment: Trigger: cron schedule (every 4h) or external webhook. To use a webhook trigger instead, change triggers[0].type to 'webhook' and use the generated URL.

blocks.name: Set Configuration Variables
blocks.comment: Central config — edit these values for your environment.

blocks.name: Run Freshness Check (Cortex Agent)
blocks.comment: Calls RUN_FRESHNESS_CHECK, which runs the agent, extracts its JSON answer, writes the audit row and returns ONE row: STATUS ('ok' | 'breach' | 'error'), TOTAL_TABLES, TABLES_OK, TABLES_BREACHED, BREACHES (JSON text), AGENT_JSON (JSON text). Agent runs can take a minute or more; allow a long query timeout.

blocks.name: SLA Breach?
blocks.comment: Reads STATUS from the first (only) row returned by run_check. Adjust the row/column reference to your tenant's output mapping for the Snowflake block.

blocks.name: Send Slack Alert
blocks.comment: Posts a breach notification to Slack. Replace with a Teams webhook or email block as needed.

body.text:
:rotating_light: *Freshness SLA Breach Detected*

*Schema:* `{$.set_variables.target_schema}`
*Tables Breached:* {$.run_check[0].TABLES_BREACHED} of {$.run_check[0].TOTAL_TABLES}
*SLA Threshold:* {$.set_variables.sla_hours} hours

Breached tables:
```
{$.run_check[0].BREACHES}
```

_Triggered by Qlik Automate → Snowflake Cortex Agent_

blocks.name: Reload Qlik App (remediation)
blocks.comment: Reloads the Qlik app that consumes the stale tables, using the native Qlik Cloud connector. Remove this block if remediation is handled differently.

blocks.name: Check Failed?
blocks.comment: STATUS 'error' means the agent returned no parseable answer. The raw response is in the audit row and in AGENT_JSON.

blocks.name: Send Slack Alert (check failed)
blocks.comment: Tells the team the freshness check itself failed, so a silent monitor doesn't look like a healthy schema.

body.text: :warning: *Freshness check failed* for `{$.set_variables.target_schema}`: the Cortex Agent returned no valid JSON answer. See FRESHNESS_AUDIT_LOG.agent_response for the raw response.

connections.name: Snowflake (key-pair auth)
connections.comment: Configure in Qlik Automate: Connections > Add > Snowflake. Use key-pair authentication with an encrypted .p8 private key and a service user whose role has the grants listed in setup.sql. See README for setup steps.
